title: clipos overview
description: Is clipos up, busy or failing: health, traffic, jobs, resources and the latest problems.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppServiceConsoleLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend app = extract(@"/sites/clipos-([a-z]+)-", 1, _ResourceId)
| extend j = parse_json(extract(@"(\{.*\})", 1, ResultDescription))
| extend level = iff(isnull(j), "TEXT", tostring(j.level)), msg = tostring(j.message), target = tostring(j.target), job_kind = tostring(j.spans[0].kind)
| where app == "api" and msg == "listening"
| project TimeGenerated, text = strcat("api started: ", substring(tostring(j.version), 0, 7))

panels.title: api health
panels.description: App Service's /healthz check on the api (100 = every check passed in the last minute).

panels.title: worker health
panels.description: App Service's /healthz check on the worker.

panels.title: Requests

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppServiceHTTPLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId has "/sites/clipos-api-" and UserAgent != "AlwaysOn" and CsUriStem != "/healthz"
| extend ms = toint(TimeTaken), status = toint(ScStatus)
| summarize count()

panels.description: Requests to the api in the time range, without Always On pings and health checks.

panels.title: 5xx

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppServiceHTTPLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId has "/sites/clipos-api-" and UserAgent != "AlwaysOn" and CsUriStem != "/healthz"
| extend ms = toint(TimeTaken), status = toint(ScStatus)
| where status >= 500
| summarize count()

panels.description: Server errors from the api in the time range.

panels.title: p95 response

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppServiceHTTPLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId has "/sites/clipos-api-" and UserAgent != "AlwaysOn" and CsUriStem != "/healthz"
| extend ms = toint(TimeTaken), status = toint(ScStatus)
| where CsUriStem !endswith "/video.mp4" and CsUriStem !endswith "/live"

panels.title: Jobs given up

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppServiceConsoleLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend app = extract(@"/sites/clipos-([a-z]+)-", 1, _ResourceId)
| extend j = parse_json(extract(@"(\{.*\})", 1, ResultDescription))
| extend level = iff(isnull(j), "TEXT", tostring(j.level)), msg = tostring(j.message), target = tostring(j.target), job_kind = tostring(j.spans[0].kind)
| where app == "worker" and isnotempty(job_kind)
| where msg == "job failed" and tostring(j.failed) == "GaveUp"
| summarize count()

panels.description: Jobs that failed for the last time (the clip shows a processing error). Retries are on the Worker dashboard.

panels.title: Logs today

azureLogAnalytics.query:
Usage
| where TimeGenerated > startofday(now()) and IsBillable
| summarize sum(Quantity)

panels.description: Log Analytics ingestion since 00:00 UTC. At the 100 MB daily cap ingestion stops until the next UTC day, and these dashboards go blank for logs.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppServiceHTTPLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId has "/sites/clipos-api-" and UserAgent != "AlwaysOn" and CsUriStem != "/healthz"
| extend ms = toint(TimeTaken), status = toint(ScStatus)

panels.title: Response time

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppServiceHTTPLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where _ResourceId has "/sites/clipos-api-" and UserAgent != "AlwaysOn" and CsUriStem != "/healthz"
| extend ms = toint(TimeTaken), status = toint(ScStatus)

panels.title: Jobs

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppServiceConsoleLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend app = extract(@"/sites/clipos-([a-z]+)-", 1, _ResourceId)
| extend j = parse_json(extract(@"(\{.*\})", 1, ResultDescription))
| extend level = iff(isnull(j), "TEXT", tostring(j.level)), msg = tostring(j.message), target = tostring(j.target), job_kind = tostring(j.spans[0].kind)
| where app == "worker" and isnotempty(job_kind)
| where msg in ("job succeeded", "job failed")
| extend outcome = iff(msg == "job succeeded", "ok", "failed")
| summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), series = strcat(job_kind, " ", outcome)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.description: Finished worker jobs by kind. A failed job is retried up to 3 times.

panels.title: Upload to analysed

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppServiceConsoleLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend app = extract(@"/sites/clipos-([a-z]+)-", 1, _ResourceId)
| extend j = parse_json(extract(@"(\{.*\})", 1, ResultDescription))
| extend level = iff(isnull(j), "TEXT", tostring(j.level)), msg = tostring(j.message), target = tostring(j.target), job_kind = tostring(j.spans[0].kind)
| where msg in ("upload complete; transcode queued", "analysed killfeed")
| extend clip = tostring(j.clip_id)
| summarize uploaded = minif(TimeGenerated, msg != "analysed killfeed"), analysed = maxif(TimeGenerated, msg == "analysed killfeed") by clip
| where isnotnull(uploaded) and isnotnull(analysed)
| project TimeGenerated = analysed, minutes = (analysed - uploaded) / 1m
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.description: Minutes from a finished upload to its killfeed analysis (transcode, queue wait and analysis). Each point is one clip.

panels.title: App Service plan
panels.description: The B2 plan the api, the worker and Grafana share. Move to B3 if memory stays above 85%.

panels.title: Postgres CPU credits
panels.description: B1ms is burstable: at 0 credits the server is held to its 20% CPU baseline.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppServiceConsoleLogs
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend app = extract(@"/sites/clipos-([a-z]+)-", 1, _ResourceId)
| extend j = parse_json(extract(@"(\{.*\})", 1, ResultDescription))
| extend level = iff(isnull(j), "TEXT", tostring(j.level)), msg = tostring(j.message), target = tostring(j.target), job_kind = tostring(j.spans[0].kind)
| where level in ("ERROR", "WARN") or (level == "TEXT" and isnotempty(trim(@"\s+", ResultDescription)))
| project TimeGenerated, app, level, ["kind"] = job_kind, message = iff(level == "TEXT", trim(@"\s+", ResultDescription), msg), error = tostring(j.error)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
